parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to force delete the custom image. Valid values: 
         
- true: Force deletes the custom image, regardless of whether the image is being used by other instances.
- false: Deletes the custom image only after checking that the image is not being used by other instances.

Default value: false.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The image ID. If the specified custom image does not exist, the request is ignored.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the custom image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
